inspector.branchHint: Describe each branch as a plain-language option; the decision model selects which one matches the latest output. If it is unsure or cannot answer, the default (empty) branch is used. Enable it under Settings → Deciders.
inspector.branches: Branches (draw an edge to the target)
inspector.coordinatorDescription: The agent runs in its own coordinator session and decides how many workers to open at runtime. The node blocks until every worker finishes and the coordinator stops; its final reply becomes the output. On timeout, active workers are stopped and the flow fails.
inspector.delayHint: Continues to the next node after waiting (up to 5 minutes).
inspector.exitJudgePlaceholder: describe the condition (for example, Review approved the change)
inspector.freshContextHint: (does not see the accumulated conversation — effective only when “Accumulate context” is enabled)
inspector.joinDescription: Waits for spawned child runs, combines their output, and stores it in {{last}}.
inspector.joinPartial: Partial mode (drop failed, waiting, or timed-out children without failing the join)
inspector.loopDescription: Repeat the body chain from the bottom body handle; then continue through the exit handle. Body nodes can use {{iteration}} (zero-based).
inspector.loopJudgeHint: After every iteration, the decision model checks whether the exit condition is satisfied. If it cannot answer, the loop continues up to the iteration limit; without a limit, the flow fails.
inspector.maxIterationsHint: 0 = stop only by the exit condition (one is required).
inspector.parallelDescription: Connect concurrent agent nodes from the bottom fan handle and the join target from the right join handle.
inspector.spawnDescription: Starts flows without blocking; a join collects their results. Async children must not be interactive (a child waiting for input causes the join to fail).
inspector.subflowDescription: If the subflow reaches await-input, this flow is suspended too. The subflow resumes when input is delivered (propagation).
inspector.subflowInputPlaceholder: empty = {{last}} · input passed to the subflow
inspector.templatePlaceholder: {{input}}, {{last}}, {{node.<id>}} — produces output without calling an LLM

nodeHelp.agent: Runs the selected agent with a templated prompt and uses its reply as output. The prompt can use variables such as {{input}}, {{last}}, and {{node.<id>}}. This is the basic node that produces one LLM step.
nodeHelp.await-input: Durably pauses the flow and waits for external input from a person or another agent. It resumes from the same point when input arrives; an optional timeout can be set. Waiting survives a server restart.
nodeHelp.branch: Routes the flow based on the latest output. The first matching branch is selected according to the match mode (contains, regex, exact match, and so on); the default branch runs if none match. It does not call an LLM.
nodeHelp.coordinator: Runs the selected agent as a coordinator: it decides at runtime how many workers to open and how to assign them. Unlike a Parallel node, its width is not fixed at design time. It waits until all workers finish and the coordinator stops, then uses the final reply as this node's output.
nodeHelp.delay: Waits for the configured duration and continues to the next node. It does not call an LLM; use it for rate limits, cooldowns, or timed steps.
nodeHelp.end: Optional terminal node. It ends the flow and can format the final output with a template or validate it against a JSON schema. Without one, the flow ends with the last node's output.
nodeHelp.join: Barrier node: waits for the child runs launched by a Spawn node, collects their output, and continues with one result.
nodeHelp.loop: Repeats its body chain until it reaches the maximum iteration count or the exit condition is satisfied. Nodes in the body can use {{iteration}} for the current iteration number.
nodeHelp.parallel: Runs multiple agent nodes at the same time, collects their results after all finish, and passes one combined output to the continuation node. Use it to speed up independent work.
nodeHelp.spawn: Starts selected flows as asynchronous child runs and continues immediately without waiting. Add a Join node later to collect their results.
nodeHelp.start: Required entry point of the flow. Execution begins here and the supplied input ({{input}}) passes directly to the next node. Every flow has exactly one.
nodeHelp.subflow: Runs another flow from start to finish, captures its output, and continues in this flow. It lets you reuse common parts instead of drawing them repeatedly.
nodeHelp.transform: Renders your template and emits it as output without calling an LLM. Use it to combine earlier results ({{last}}, {{node.<id>}}), reformat content, or inject fixed text.

async-fanout.name: Async Fan-out (Spawn/Join)
async-fanout.description: Starts two analysis subflows concurrently without blocking, collects their results at a join barrier, then combines them into one reply. Partial mode is enabled, so the join continues if one branch fails. The two companion subflows are created and connected automatically.

branch-router.name: Sentiment Router
branch-router.description: Branching flow: analyzes sentiment first, then responds with thanks for positive input or an apology for negative input.

classify-act.name: Classify & Route
classify-act.description: Classifies input as bug, feature, or question and routes each category to its own handler. A deterministic Flow equivalent of the coordinator Classify-And-Act pattern.

critique-loop.name: Critique & Revise
critique-loop.description: Draft → critique → revise. One agent creates, a second finds flaws, and a third fixes them.

default-starter.name: Answer & Verify
default-starter.description: The default flow automatically added to every workspace. One agent answers the request; a second finds errors and gaps and produces a corrected final version.

experts-synthesis.name: Multiple Experts + Synthesis
experts-synthesis.description: Three experts answer the same question concurrently from different angles; one agent synthesizes their views.

gan-loop.name: Generator↔Evaluator (GAN)
gan-loop.description: A contract-based generate → evaluate → refine loop. A producing agent and a separate skeptical evaluator refine or pivot based on the score. Uses Playwright for real UI/E2E checks. Assign two different agents.

generate-filter.name: Generate & Filter
generate-filter.description: Generates many candidates from different angles in parallel, then one agent removes duplicates, scores them with a rubric, and selects the strongest few. A Flow equivalent of the Generate-And-Filter pattern.

pipeline.name: Sequential Pipeline
pipeline.description: Research → draft → polish. Produces a polished short text from one topic.

planner-executor.name: Plan & Execute
planner-executor.description: A planner splits the task into steps, an executor carries them out, and a summarizer reports the result.

pros-cons.name: Pros and Cons Analysis
pros-cons.description: Parallel fan-out + join: two agents write arguments for and against at the same time; a third produces a balanced conclusion.

tournament.name: Tournament
tournament.description: Four candidates are generated in parallel, two semifinal judges select the winners of each pair, and a final judge chooses the champion. A deterministic Flow equivalent of the Tournament pattern.
